name: Create New Task
description: Workflow for creating a new task with To Do status. Captures task details, validates the information, creates the task record, and notifies relevant stakeholders.

inputVariables.description: The title or name of the task to be created

inputVariables.name: taskPriority
inputVariables.description: Priority level of the task (low, medium, high)

inputVariables.name: assignedTo
inputVariables.description: User ID or email of the person assigned to the task

data.description: Task creation workflow completed successfully

config.title: Task Details
config.description: Provide information about the task you want to create

config.title: Task Management Best Practices
config.message: Use clear, actionable titles and set realistic deadlines. Break down complex tasks into smaller subtasks for better tracking.

items.title: How to name tasks effectively
items.content: Start with an action verb (e.g., 'Review', 'Create', 'Update') and be specific about the outcome. Avoid vague titles like 'Work on project'.

items.title: Setting task priorities
items.content: High priority for urgent and important tasks, Medium for important but not urgent, Low for nice-to-have items. Review priorities regularly.

items.title: Managing deadlines
items.content: Set realistic deadlines with buffer time. Consider dependencies and team availability when scheduling tasks.

config.text: Need help? Contact support or view our task management guide.
